'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Brian Herold LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Castle Bravo. Transcription note: 2002-style form (36+24 lines); margin joke protest is not deck content

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
